title: Qt: Fix File Path editor in table
description:
The current situation in UatDelegate as well as PathChooserDelegate
leads to issues, where Wireshark crashes if the button is clicked. This
is due to the UI not correctly positioning the button inside the cell.

This change implements a widget, which will serve as cell content,
handling all relations with choosing the file, but also properly
handling the size and geometry of said cell content, therefore no longer
leading to crashes and cleaning up code at the same time, as duplicate
methods are being removed.

Fixes #17789 
Fixes #17819 
Fixes #18088

The patch is ready to be commited. Although it has a few issues:

- Focus is not 100%. This is due to a restriction inside how Qt handles TreeViews and TableViews. Changing this would lead an incredible amount of code for a very simple feature. The only rammification currently for the user is, that if the textedit has lost focus and he hits enter, not only will the line be saved, but also the dialog closed (as the enter goes to the ok button). 
- The height is higher than the table row. This cannot be helped. The LineEdit has 21 as minimumHeight. It cannot be reduced further. The font size could be reduced, but than it would also be unreadable on big screens (it is very small as it is), and I was not able to reduce the height below 20. For reference, the row height is 17. Second, the ToolButton is also 21. That cannot be removed. So either we create widgets where we have to rewrite the complete print routine, or let it overflow a bit during edit.
- The UAT Table will start a little bit to the right. The reason behind that has nothing todo with this change, but rather with UatModel, where columns not being used or seen by the user are being shown with invisible data. The model does not take into consideration, that some columns should not be displayed. Changing this is an issue for another time.
enabled an automatic merge when the pipeline for 2e01373dee5ca2949c53e253765cc9cfd6a86c2e succeeds

This doesn't work right for the UAT case. The editor is useless (browsing to a file is fine). Every single time a character is entered, the field becomes not editable, and the user has to click again.

It seems that is because of the `UatDialog::resizeColumns()` call that happens after the validation. (Most of the other UAT line editors do their own validation, and only submit data to the UAT for its validation after Enter is pressed, instead of after every character.)

It works fine for entering in the pipe name.
Specifically, in `UatDialog::resizeColumns()`, it seems that the calls to `ui->uatTreeView->setVisible();` disrupt the editor.
